notes: Original title verified against Columbia-hosted full PDF https://business.columbia.edu/sites/default/files-efs/imce-uploads/CDS/defaults_framing_and_privacy.pdf. Study identifier 2 selects Experiment 2; supplied original p.8 describes Experiment 1, so its statistics were not substituted. Original es records the printed t statistic without conversion. Replication narrative reports OR 0.75 and p .095; Table 7 Model 2 gives OR 0.75 with p 0.096 and CI [0.54, 1.05], while Model 1 reports OR 0.95, p 0.724. The extracted OR and p are paired exactly as printed in the target results narrative; these discrepant model/table values were not merged.
